name: Kristen Applebees
source: Kristen Applebees thought her senior year at the Aguefort Adventuring Academy was going perfectly. As senior class president, she just pulled off the best Valentine's Day dance the school has ever seen! But her high spirits are quickly brought down by none other than Principal Arthur Aguefort, who reveals to her that his contract with the celestial plane requires that he kill any clerics who fail to represent their god  with a date at the Spring Fling. As it happens, Kristen is the only follower of Cassandra, so that responsibility rests solely on her.
